content:
The abolition of the Eigenmietwert (own-occupation value) in Switzerland was a result of the Swiss Federal People's Initiative "For a Fair Tax System" which was accepted in a referendum on June 13, 2021.

The new rules will apply for the tax year starting January 1, 2022.

Regarding your mortgage, the abolition of the Eigenmietwert does not directly affect your mortgage payments. Amortization of your mortgage continues to be a separate financial decision based on your personal financial situation and goals. There are no changes to your obligation to make mortgage payments due to the abolition of the Eigenmietwert.

It's advisable to consult with a tax advisor or financial advisor to understand the complete implications of this change on your specific financial situation.
